title: ikuku layered-delivery manifest
description: Describes the ordered stack of layers that assemble a prospect-specific ERPNext distro. See docs/LAYERS.md.

distro.description: WSL distro name the base imports as. Almost always 'ikuku'.

id.description: Unique layer id within the manifest.

order.description: Ascending apply order. Higher layers may overwrite lower ones.

role.description: Layer role; drives caching policy and reseller swappability.

artifact.description: Tarball filename relative to the kit / cache root (e.g. *.tar, *.tar.zst, *.vhdx).

sha256.description: Content digest of the artifact. Used for cache hits and integrity.

cache.description: machine: cache under C:\ikuku\cache, reuse across all kits. industry: reuse across prospects of same vertical. none: never cached, always ships.

applyMode.description: import: this layer IS the rootfs (wsl --import; --vhd for .vhdx); exactly one layer, must be order 0. overlay: tar extracted over the running distro root by the in-guest composer.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the layer's contents.
